description: The bar chart illustrates Shapley values for a set of morphosyntactic feature categories, shown separately for three models (mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM). The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled (left to right) L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, and the vertical axis is labeled “Shapley value” on a linear scale ranging from 0 up to about 80 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Each category has a grouped set of three adjacent bars: mBERT is light blue, XLM-R is dark blue, and chLSTM is light green, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. Approximate bar heights are: for L₄⁺, mBERT ~5, XLM-R ~6, chLSTM ~0; for L₃, mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~2, chLSTM ~0; for L₂, mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~5, chLSTM ~1; for L₁, mBERT ~13, XLM-R ~14, chLSTM ~13; for T, mBERT ~59, XLM-R ~55, chLSTM ~79; for R₁, mBERT ~10, XLM-R ~11, chLSTM ~9; for R₂, mBERT ~2, XLM-R ~3, chLSTM slightly below 0; for R₃, mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~1, chLSTM slightly below 0; and for R₄⁺, mBERT ~5, XLM-R ~5, chLSTM slightly below 0. The bars are arranged in fixed category order (not visibly sorted by value), and there are no special visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the legend and gridlines.
